craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of marshalled examples — parity and fencing. Reply-frame opened; strange-way kept strange; somehow kept. Rejected: (a) strange→odd → killed: strange keeps wonder. Read aloud: HERE is-THE re-PLY … A-JOIN-ing.

lines: Here is the reply: a strange way of helpers is seen —
some would join with stuff, somehow — a joining.
l4.sanskrit_cite: atrocyate gatiścitrā dṛśyate sahakāriṇām kecitkathaṃcideveyurupādānaiḥ samāgamam

reads_against.argmap: What strange way of helpers? → Reply-frame opened: helpers show a strange way — some joining with materials somehow.
c1_essence: Stock examples turned: eye-fitness shows the higher self; smoke-fire proves khadira-wood by mere knowing (vv10-11).
The hetu fenced, others sifting, the whole Lord-made; helpers' strange way opened, pictured, and bounded; fancied spread refused (vv12-18).
